name: Discover, public Roblox game shelf and mobile navigation
description: Verify the home feed and the main destinations.
steps: Confirm the featured experience shelf renders
Navigate to Catalog, Avatar, Profile and Inventory
expected: Discover loads first; the main destinations work and the simulator watermark remains visible.

name: Live public Roblox catalog search
description: Search the live public Roblox catalog and confirm the cached creator shelf remains available as fallback.
steps: Repeat with a term that has no matches
expected: Public results render from the catalog API; if unavailable, the app clearly labels the curated fallback.

name: TikTok creator UGC source cards
covers: no false claim of video playback
description: Verify the four creator-linked catalog finds and their source metadata.
steps: Inspect the creator cards and post captions
Open the matching Roblox catalog listing
expected: Cards show the creator's public caption metadata and original links; the app does not claim the video itself was watched.

name: Avatar editor and outfit presets
description: Customize a local avatar and save or restore multiple outfits.
steps: Change skin, shirt and pants colors
Change the appearance again and load the saved preset
expected: Avatar preview changes immediately; saved presets restore appearance and equipped items locally.

name: Public Roblox profile, friends, games, badges and favorites import
description: Import available public Roblox profile data without credentials.
steps: Open Backstage and import a public username
expected: Public endpoints populate the appropriate sections; private or unavailable data shows a clear error without bypassing privacy.

name: Backstage profile controls and local persistence
description: Verify Backstage and local profile customization.
steps: Hold the top edge for about one second
Edit display name, bio, followers and demo Robux
Upload an avatar or cover image
expected: Edits persist locally and the simulator watermark remains visible on every page.

name: Inventory, local demo currency and data portability
covers: no real Roblox purchases or account changes
description: Verify inventory, demo-only purchase behavior and backup/restore.
expected: Inventory and demo balance change locally only; JSON backup restores state and reset requires confirmation.
